canon-age.text: If in the Roman Rite, the first part of this Prayer, the Preface, has preserved diverse formulation in the course of the centuries, the second part, on the contrary, called "Canon of the Action," took on an unchangeable form during the fourth and fifth centuries; conversely, the Eastern liturgies allowed for this variety in their anaphoras.
canon-age.notes: St. Paul VI, Apostolic Constitution Missale Romanum, 3 April 1969. Ch. 10: age of the Roman Canon.
